title: Why Research Matters
gist: Paywalled teaser: Peter N. Miller argues that over the past 21 months the US government has slashed research funding, closed research centers, politicized grant-making and bullied universities, with costs far greater than many realize.

insights.claim: Over the past 21 months, the US government has been slashing research funding, closing research centers, politicizing grant-making decisions and bullying universities, the country's single biggest research engine.
insights.speaker: Peter N. Miller
insights.so_what: Reduced public research funding threatens the US innovation pipeline feeding biotech, tech and university spinouts.
insights.quote: slashing funding for it, closing centers where it is done, politicizing grant-making decisions, and bullying its single biggest engine: universities

insights.claim: The costs of cutting research in the country that has leveraged it to greatest effect will be far greater than many realize.
insights.speaker: Peter N. Miller
insights.so_what: Long-dated innovation and productivity drag may be underpriced; watch talent and research migration abroad.
insights.quote: The costs will be far greater than many realize.
